name: vertex-order-kit
description: Build-time only. Node drives scripts/ssr-render.js (`just build`'s SSR step) via jsdom; react/react-dom are pinned to the exact versions site/support.js loads from unpkg at runtime (site/support.js REACT_URL/REACT_DOM_URL), so the prerendered markup matches what the client re-renders. Never shipped to the browser. dependencies/devDependencies split is: needed to produce the build artifact (jsdom/react/react-dom) vs. needed only to lint/format-check (everything else) -- `npm install` here always installs both regardless (nothing in this repo's pipeline ever does a --omit=dev install), so the split documents intent rather than gating what gets installed. All exact-pinned (no `^`) so Dependabot (see .github/dependabot.yml, 7-day cooldown) proposes one reviewable bump at a time instead of silently floating.
